blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Assessing large language models for linguistic annotation requires task-specific evaluation under documented conditions. We present dhAIBench, a Python benchmarking and annotation tool with a web interface for exploring and sharing results. It records prompts, configurations and predictions, enabling comparisons of annotation quality, confidence calibration, repeatability and estimated cost. We demonstrate the framework and the associated methodology through 293 runs of 48 models on nine linguistic annotation tasks spanning morphology, syntax, semantics, discourse-pragmatics, spelling normalization and learner-language correction. Models achieve high agreement with reference annotations on several tasks, including those on non-standardized, historical varieties as well as requiring contextual interpretation. The results support evaluating models against specific linguistic tasks, rather than relying on general rankings. To this end, we make the current and future benchmarks publicly available at dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz.
blocks.zh: 评估用于语言注释的大型语言模型需要在有文件记载的条件下进行针对具体任务的评价. 我们提出dhAI Bench,这是一个Python基准和注释工具,有一个网页界面,用于探索和分享结果。 它记录了提示、配置和预测,从而能够对注释质量、信心校准、可重复性和估计费用进行比较。 我们通过涉及9个语言注释任务的293个模型展示了框架和相关方法,这些模型涉及形态学、语法、语义学、语法学、拼写正常化和学习者语言校正。 模型就若干任务,包括非标准化的历史品种和需要背景解释的任务,达成了高度一致的参考说明。 结果支持对照特定语言任务评价模型,而不是依赖一般排名. 为此,我们在dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz公布目前和未来的基准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A substantial portion of linguistic research depends on decisions about what a form means, which grammatical category it instantiates and how it functions in context – in other words, on linguistic annotation. Making these decisions at corpus scale requires an automated annotation procedure whose outputs can be inspected and whose limitations are understood. Automated annotation has traditionally relied on dedicated natural language processing (NLP) tools, which can offer computational efficiency and reproducible results for well-defined tasks. LLMs offer a practical means of applying instructions expressed in ordinary language, including instructions for categories that are less strictly defined or that apply to non-standardized varieties and therefore poorly served by existing software, without requiring a separately trained model for each task. Their usefulness therefore raises an empirical question: under which conditions do their annotations provide dependable evidence for a linguistic analysis?
blocks.zh: 语言研究的很大一部分取决于对一种形式的含义、它究竟是什么语法分类以及它如何在语境中发挥作用——换句话说,取决于语言注释——的决定。 作出这些决定必须采用自动说明程序,其产出可以检查,其局限性可以理解。 自动注释传统上依赖于专用的自然语言处理(NLP)工具,这些工具可以为定义明确的任务提供计算效率和可复制的结果. LLMs提供了应用普通语言表达的指令的实用手段,包括针对定义较不严格或适用于非标准品种,因此现有软件服务差的类别,而不需要为每项任务单独培训的模型. 因此,它们的有用性提出了一个经验问题:其说明在什么条件下为语言分析提供可靠的证据?

blocks.en: Studies of genre identification, semantic classification and multilingual tasks illustrate the potential of LLM annotation and the variation in performance between applications ( Kuzman et al. 2023 ; Lai et al. 2023 ; Koeva 2024 ) . Assessing suitability for a new project nevertheless remains difficult. Reports of LLM use in linguistic research do not always specify model versions, prompts, generation settings and evaluation procedures in sufficient detail for the results to be easily reproduced or compared. Popular benchmarking sites and general-purpose leaderboards, meanwhile, do not focus on linguistic annotation. Researchers consequently need a practical way to establish whether the annotations required for their study can be usefully and efficiently automated using LLMs, choose an appropriate model, and carry out the annotation without necessarily having advanced programming skills.
blocks.zh: 对流派识别、语义分类和多语种任务的研究表明,LLM注释的潜力和应用程序之间的性能变化(Kuzman等人)。 2023; Lai et al. 2023; Koeva 2024 ). 然而,评估新项目是否合适仍然很困难。 关于语言研究中使用LLM的报告并不总是足够详细地规定模型版本、提示、生成设置和评价程序,以便便于复制或比较结果。 同时,受欢迎的基准点和通用领导板并不注重语言注释。 因此,研究人员需要一种切实可行的方法来确定其研究所需的说明是否可以有用和高效率地使用LLMS进行自动化,选择适当的模型,并进行注释,而不一定具备先进的编程技能。

blocks.en: Our resources do not permit a comprehensive or representative survey of linguistic annotation tasks across all available LLMs. We have therefore developed dhAIBench around three complementary resources: a benchmarking tool that researchers can use with their own data; a web application for exploring and analyzing the benchmarks produced by the tool; and a public website that collects and presents shared results. The tool supports both benchmarking against reference annotations and using the selected model to annotate additional research data. Together, these resources aim to make task-specific evaluation and subsequent annotation more accessible, while preserving the information needed to interpret and compare the results.
blocks.zh: 我们的资源无法对所有现有的法学硕士课程进行全面或有代表性的语言注释工作调查。 因此,我们围绕三个补充资源开发了dhAI Bench:一个可供研究人员利用自己数据的基准工具;一个用于探索和分析该工具所产生的基准的网络应用程序;以及一个收集和介绍共同成果的公共网站。 该工具既支持参照参考说明制定基准,也支持使用选定的模型来说明其他研究数据。 这些资源合在一起,旨在使针对具体任务的评价和随后的说明更容易获得,同时保存解释和比较结果所需的信息。

blocks.en: To establish an initial collection and demonstrate the workflow, we contribute benchmarks for nine tasks covering several levels of linguistic description, from morphology and syntax to semantics and discourse-pragmatics, alongside historical text normalization and learner-language correction. The tasks concern English to make the examples accessible to a broad readership, while giving attention also to less commonly evaluated varieties. This selection illustrates uses of the framework within the resources available to us.
blocks.zh: 为了建立初步汇编并展示工作流程,我们为9项任务提供了基准,这些任务涵盖语言描述的几个层次,从形态学和语法到语义学和语义学,以及历史文本正常化和学习者语言校正。 这些任务涉及英文,使广大读者能够查阅实例,同时注意评价较少的品种。 这一选择表明,我们在现有资源范围内利用了该框架。

blocks.en: These benchmarks cannot be used to establish a general leaderboard of models for linguistic annotations and they are unlikely to match the precise data, categories and analytical requirements of most other projects. They can nevertheless provide provisional points of comparison. A researcher considering a morphological annotation task, for example, can examine the accuracy achieved on another morphological task, the models used and any reported time and monetary costs. Such comparisons can inform an initial choice of models and a judgement about feasibility; the acceptable level of accuracy must still be determined for the intended analysis. We therefore encourage researchers to benchmark their own tasks and to share their results for inclusion on the website.
blocks.zh: 这些基准不能用来为语言说明建立一个通用的模型领导板,也不可能与大多数其他项目的精确数据、类别和分析要求相匹配。 不过,它们可以提供临时的比较点。 例如,考虑形态学注释任务的研究人员可以检查另一项形态学任务取得的准确性,所使用的模型以及任何报告的时间和货币成本. 这种比较可为初步选择模型和判断可行性提供参考;对于预期的分析,仍须确定可接受的准确度。 因此,我们鼓励研究人员制定自己的任务基准,并分享结果,以便列入网站。

blocks.en: Our longer-term aim is to broaden the collection through contributions from other researchers. Even an expanded collection will remain incomplete: models are continually introduced and retired. Retirement can prevent a new task from being evaluated with an older model, while testing every existing task with each newly available model would exceed the resources of the project. The collection is thus intended to grow as a shared record of task-specific evaluations. This chapter describes the tools and initial benchmarks, and discusses how their results can support decisions about LLM annotation.
blocks.zh: 我们的长期目标是通过其他研究人员的贡献来扩大收藏。 即使扩大的收藏也仍然不完整:模型不断被引入和退役。 退休可以防止用较旧的模式来评价一项新任务,而用每个新的模式来测试每一项现有任务将超过项目的资源。 因此,该汇编旨在作为具体任务评价的共同记录而增长。 本章描述了工具和初步基准,并讨论了这些工具和基准的结果如何能够支持关于LLM注释的决定。

blocks.en: 2 Linguistic Annotation and LLM benchmarking
blocks.zh: 2 语言说明和LLM基准

blocks.en: Linguistic annotations are explicit decisions about particular instances of language use that depend on the annotation unit, category definitions, available context and conventions for ambiguous cases. Agreement with reference annotations therefore measures conformity to an operational definition; it does not independently establish the validity of the underlying analysis. Research on inter-annotator agreement distinguishes these questions ( Artstein and Poesio 2008 ) , while work on human label variation shows that disagreements can reflect defensible differences in interpretation rather than annotator error alone ( Plank 2022 ) . These considerations apply equally to human annotation, conventional NLP tools and LLMs.
blocks.zh: 语言说明是对具体语言使用情况的明确决定,这些决定取决于说明单位、类别定义、可用上下文和关于模棱两可案例的公约。 因此,同意参考说明,衡量是否符合业务定义;它并不独立确定基本分析的有效性。 关于注释者间协议的研究将这些问题区分开来(Artstein and Poesio 2008 ),而关于人类标签变异的研究表明,分歧可以反映解释上的合理差异,而不只是注释者的错误(Plank 2022 ). 这些考虑同样适用于人的注释、传统的NLP工具和LLMs。

blocks.en: 2.1 From dedicated NLP tools to prompted annotation
blocks.zh: 2.1 从专用NLP工具引出注释

blocks.en: Established NLP pipelines commonly implement annotation through rules, lexical resources or models trained for particular tasks. Where suitable tools exist, they can provide efficient processing, consistent output structures and reproducible application of a specified annotation scheme. Their suitability nevertheless depends on the relationship between their original design and the researcher’s data. Applying an existing tagger to historical correspondence, for example, requires consideration of differences in spelling, grammatical usage and annotation conventions. Adapting a pipeline to new categories or varieties may require programming, additional lexical resources or labelled training data.
blocks.zh: 已建立的NLP管道通常通过为特定任务培训的规则、词汇资源或模型进行注释。 在有适当工具的情况下,它们可以提供高效的处理,一致的输出结构,以及可再生产地应用特定注解方案. 然而,它们的适宜性取决于它们的最初设计和研究人员的数据之间的关系。 例如,将现有的标记器应用于历史通信需要考虑拼写、语法使用和注释公约方面的差异。 使管道适应新的类别或品种可能需要方案编制、额外的词汇资源或贴标签的培训数据。

blocks.en: LLMs belong within NLP, but their use through prompting changes how researchers can specify an annotation task. Category definitions, decision rules, examples and contextual information can be supplied in ordinary language without training a separate model for each application. Brown et al. ( 2020 ) demonstrated this capacity to specify tasks and examples through textual interaction without updating model parameters. For linguistic research, this makes it possible to experiment with categories that are absent from existing annotation tools. It does not remove the need to define those categories carefully or to obtain reference annotations for evaluation.
blocks.zh: LLMs属于NLP内部,但通过催化改变其用途,研究者如何指定注释任务. 类别定义、决定规则、实例和背景资料可以用普通语言提供,无需为每个应用程序培训单独的模型。 布朗等人著. (2020)通过文本交互,在不更新模型参数的情况下,证明了这种指定任务和实例的能力. 对于语言学研究来说,这使得对现有注释工具中没有的类别进行实验成为可能. 它并未排除仔细界定这些类别或获得评价参考说明的必要性。

blocks.en: Prompting also makes the instructions part of the evaluated system. Changing a category description, adding examples or supplying grammatical metadata changes the information available to the model. Even changes that preserve the intended meaning can affect performance: Sclar et al. ( 2024 ) document substantial sensitivity to prompt formatting in few-shot classification. A benchmark consequently evaluates a model under a particular prompting procedure.
blocks.zh: 提示还使指示成为评价系统的一部分。 更改一个类别描述,添加实例或提供语法元数据会改变模型可获得的信息. 即使保留预期含义的改变也会影响性能: 斯克拉尔等人. (2024)记录了对以少拍分类方式迅速格式化的实质性敏感性. 因此,一个基准对特定提示程序下的模型进行评价。

blocks.en: The relationship between linguistic conventions and computational implementation is particularly apparent in historical text processing. Bollmann ( 2019 ) compares normalization systems based on several methodological traditions and highlights difficulties arising from different datasets and evaluation procedures. Hämäläinen et al. ( 2019 ) show that lexical resources can improve neural normalization through filtering candidate outputs. Such findings also motivate treating dictionaries, normalization rules and validators as components of an annotation system whose contribution must be recorded alongside that of the model.
blocks.zh: 语言公约与计算执行之间的关系在历史文本处理中尤其明显. 博尔曼(2019年)根据几种方法传统比较正常化系统,突出不同数据集和评价程序产生的困难. Hämäläinen等人(2019年)表明,词汇资源可以通过过滤候选产出来改善神经正常化. 这种结论还促使将字典、正常化规则和验证者视为注释系统的组成部分,其贡献必须与模型的贡献一并记录。

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmark design and reproducibility
blocks.zh: 2.2 基准设计和可复制性

blocks.en: A benchmark for linguistic annotation should establish how well a specified annotation procedure meets the requirements of an intended research task. Its design must define the linguistic phenomenon and annotation categories, the source and sampling of material, and the reference annotations against which predictions are assessed. The evaluated procedure includes both the model and the conditions of its use: the instructions, contextual information and examples supplied to it, together with any constraints or subsequent validation of its outputs. Benchmark scores must therefore be interpreted in relation to these conditions.
blocks.zh: 语言注释的基准应确定具体注释程序在多大程度上符合预定研究任务的要求。 它的设计必须界定语言现象和注释类别,材料的来源和取样,以及据以评估预测的参考说明。 评价的程序包括模型及其使用条件:向其提供的指示、背景资料和实例,以及对其产出的任何限制或随后的验证。 因此,必须根据这些条件来解释基准分数。

blocks.en: Evaluation should also reflect the practical requirements of linguistic research. Agreement with reference annotations is central, but aggregate accuracy alone may conceal poor performance on categories important to the analysis. Coverage, consistency between runs, the reliability of confidence estimates and computational costs provide additional evidence about whether an annotation procedure is suitable for use ( Liang et al. 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 评价还应反映语言研究的实际要求。 同意参考说明是中心问题,但单是总的准确性可能掩盖分析重要类别的不良业绩。 覆盖面、运行之间的一致性、信任估计的可靠性和计算费用,为说明程序是否适合使用提供了额外证据(梁等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We use the node as the annotation unit: a predefined word, multiword expression or skip-gram, supplied with context and optional metadata in a format resembling a keyword-in-context (KWIC) corpus export. Each request concerns one node, without conversational history from other items. This simplifies benchmarking: each prediction can be compared directly with the reference label for the same node. Annotating complete texts may additionally require matching predicted and reference spans, whose boundaries can differ. Our procedure separates annotation from instance detection and segmentation, so scores measure agreement on supplied targets rather than the ability to identify instances in unprocessed text. 1 1 1 Detection or segmentation can also be evaluated over predefined units using labels to encode target membership or segment boundaries. Users can, for example, process a text word by word but always with the whole text supplied for context and with annotations representing the desired segmentation. Repeating instructions and context, however, increases resource use.
blocks.zh: 我们使用节点作为注释单位:一个预定义的单词,多字表达式或跳格格,以类似关键字(KWIC)导出的格式提供上下文和可选元数据. 每次请求都涉及一个节点,没有其他项目的对话历史. 这简化了基准:每个预测可以直接与同一节点的参考标签进行比较. 说明完整的文本可能还需要匹配预测的和参考的跨度,其界限可能有所不同。 我们的程序将注释与实例检测和分解区分开来,因此分数衡量对所提供目标的协议,而不是在未处理文本中识别实例的能力。 1,1 检测或分区也可以在预定义的单位上评价,使用标签编码目标成员或分区边界. 例如,用户可以逐字处理一个文本字,但总是用整个文本提供上下文,并附加说明,代表理想的分割. 但是,重复的指示和上下文增加了资源的使用。

blocks.en: The technical description below explains how dhAIBench records inputs, settings and outputs and supports evaluation and review of individual predictions.
blocks.zh: 以下技术说明解释了dhAI Bench如何记录投入、设置和产出,并支持对个别预测的评价和审查。

blocks.en: 3.1 Technical description
blocks.zh: 3.1 技术说明

blocks.en: The implementation has three main components: a Python benchmarking script with a browser-based configuration interface, optional external validators and a static metrics dashboard -- all freely available from a GitHub repository. 2 2 2 The public repository is at https://github.com/otichy/dhAIBench , the public instance of the web app with our benchmarking results is at https://dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz/
blocks.zh: 实施有三个主要组成部分: Python 基准脚本,带有一个基于浏览器的配置界面,可选的外部验证器和一个静态的度量衡仪表板——都从一个GitHub寄存器中免费获得. 2个 2 公共资料库见https://github.com/obtichy/dhAI Bench。 具有基准结果的网络应用程序的公开实例见https://dhaibench.silent3.ff.cuni.cz/

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Benchmarking script
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 基准脚本

blocks.en: The script reads semicolon-delimited CSV files with at least ID and node fields. Optional leftContext and rightContext fields supply the immediate surroundings, while info supplies task-relevant metadata. The rest of fields are never sent to the model. An optional truth column, or a separate ID--label file, supplies the reference labels for evaluation. This separation permits scoring against annotations that the model does not see for the target item. 3 3 3 By default, the runs are zero-shot (no example of a correct annotation is provided to the model), but the user can either include examples in the prompt or can set a number of input truth labels to be provided to the model.
blocks.zh: 脚本读取至少带有ID和节点字段的分号限制的CSV文件. 可选的左侧Context和右侧Context字段提供近邻,而信息则提供与任务相关的元数据. 其余的田地从未被送往模型. 可选的真理栏,或单独的ID-label文件,为评价提供参考标签. 这种分离使模型无法看到目标项目的说明得到评分。 3 3 3 默认情况下,运行为0射(没有为模型提供正确注释的例子),但用户可以或者在即时输入中加入示例,或者可以设置一些输入的真假标签,提供给模型.

blocks.en: Other input columns are retained in the output (e.g. to preserve a complete multi-column corpus export, user comments etc.), but do not enter the process in any way.
blocks.zh: 其他输入列保留在输出中(如保存完整的多列导出,用户评论等),但不以任何方式进入过程.

blocks.en: For the standard, single-item workflow, the script constructs a task-level system prompt and an item-level user prompt. The system prompt is based on user task-specific annotation instructions and general instructions on the prompt-response exchange, while the user prompt is generated from the input data per each annotation item. 4 4 4 The division between system and user prompt allows for caching the system prompt, which remains the same for all items of a task, and leads to more efficient and cheaper runs. The node is marked explicitly, and a classification_target field identifies either the complete node or marked internal spans (e.g. in cases of discontinuous linguistic structures). The requested JSON response from the model contains the prediction, an optional explanation and confidence (as estimated by the model in its answer and/or as token logprobs), and fields echoing the target and its source. Checking the echoed span helps detect a well-formed answer about the wrong piece of text; it does not establish that the linguistic label is correct. 5 5 5 User can set a number of automatic retries in cases the answer is malformed or the node is not echoed correctly.
blocks.zh: 对于标准,单项工作流程,脚本构建任务级系统即时,项目级用户即时. 系统速报是基于用户特定任务的说明说明和关于即时响应交换的一般指示,而用户速报则来自每个注释项的输入数据. 页:1 4,系统与用户即时的划分允许缓冲系统即时,对于一项任务中的所有项目来说,均保持不变,并导致更有效和更便宜的运行. 节点被明确标记,一个分类_目标字段可以识别完整的节点或标记的内部跨度(如在语言结构不连续的情况下). 从模型中请求的JSON响应包含预测,可选解释和信心(模型在答案和/或符号日志中估计),以及与目标及其源相呼应的字段. 检查反射跨度有助于检测出关于错误文本的成形答案;它并不确定语言标签是正确的. 5 5 用户可以在答案不正确或节点不正确的情况下设置若干自动重试.

blocks.en: In this workflow, each target is classified without conversational memory of previously classified items.
blocks.zh: 在这个工作流程中,每个目标都被分类,没有以前分类的项目的对话内存.

blocks.en: The configuration records model and provider identifiers, generation controls and operational settings such as concurrency, request spacing, caching, timeouts and retries. Supported controls include temperature, top-p and, where available, top-k, reasoning effort and provider-specific thinking effort settings. User can also set descriptive metadata like task name, description and tags that are useful for later analysis.
blocks.zh: 配置记录模型和提供者标识符,生成控制和操作设置,如货币,请求间隔,缓存,超时和重试. 支持的控制包括温度,上p,如果有的话,上k,推理努力和提供者特有的思维努力设置. 用户还可以设置任务名称,描述和标记等描述性元数据,用于日后的分析.

blocks.en: The complete details of the script’s parametrization is part of its documentation. Because the settings are relatively complex, there is also a web-based configuration where the user can set the run up using a user-friendly GUI and then copy the resulting command to run the script.
blocks.zh: 剧本的全貌细节是其文件的一部分。 由于设置相对复杂,因此也有一个基于网络的配置,用户可以使用方便用户的GUI来设置运行,然后复制由此产生的命令来运行脚本.

blocks.en: Predictions are saved in a CSV containing the input and response fields. Newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) prompt logs record per-attempt information, while metrics and all the run parameters are saved in JSON and can be recomputed without issuing new model requests. Resume mode reuses saved rows by ID to support recovery from interruption but also allows to re-prompt any records so labeled as unclassified. 6 6 6 Records can be labeled as unclassified by the model due to technical issues (malformed answer, incorrect node identification), but also because the model was not able to decide what label to apply. Since the models behavior is usually stochastic, this may be alleviated by a re-prompt.
blocks.zh: 预测保存在包含输入和响应字段的CSV中. Newline-discription JSON(NDJSON)在不发布新型号请求的情况下,迅速将日志记录为每个试运行信息,而度量衡和所有运行参数则保存在JSON中,可以重算. 恢复模式再利用用ID保存的行支持中断恢复,但也允许重新推动任何被标记为未分类的记录. 6 6 6 记录可以由于技术问题(错误的答案,错误的节点识别)而被模型标注为未分类,但也因为模型无法决定应用什么标签. 由于模型行为通常具有斯图克性,这可能会通过重新瞬间来缓解.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Validators

The script can start an external validator and communicate with it through one JSON message per attempt over standard input and output. A validator is a deterministic process (e.g. a Python script) that can accept a prediction, optionally normalize it, request a retry with a restricted candidate label list and explanatory message, or abort the run. Retries reconstruct the base prompt and append the validator feedback.
blocks.zh: 脚本可以启动一个外部验证器,并通过每次尝试一次JSON消息在标准输入和输出上与它通信. 校验符是一个确定性的过程(如Python脚本),可以接受一个预测,可选地使其正常化,请求使用限制的候选标签列表和解释性消息进行重试,或者中止运行. Retries 重建基础提示并附加验证器反馈 。

blocks.en: This architecture is useful e.g. for tasks with large, allowed label sets like lemmatization or normalization where including a complete dictionary in every prompt would be costly or impractical. Candidate generation can use e.g. lexical resources, string distance or part-of-speech information. It combines linguistic constraints with model selection while keeping deterministic transformations outside the language model. However, an accepted dictionary entry can still be the wrong lemma in context. Validator acceptance and linguistic correctness are separate outcomes.
blocks.zh: 例如,这种架构对于大型、允许的标签套件,如Lemmatization或正常化等任务很有用,在每一个提示中都包含一个完整的字典,费用昂贵或不切实际。 候选生成可以使用词汇资源,字符串距离或部分语音信息等. 它将语言约束与模型选择相结合,同时保持语言模型以外的决定性转变. 然而,在上下文中,一个被接受的字典条目仍然可能是错误的lemma. 验证器接受和语言正确性是分别的结果.

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Metrics web app
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 计量网络应用

blocks.en: The browser dashboard is designed to be used locally by individual researchers to analyze their runs or online to share the interactive results publicly. It can load a local metrics folder or a server collection and filter runs by task, model, tags and time. Its views expose accuracy and other label metrics 7 7 7 Metrics definitions: Accuracy : exact-match rate, i.e. the share of examples where predicted label = gold label. Brier score : mean squared error between confidence and correctness; lower is better. Expected Calibration Error (ECE) : average gap between stated confidence and actual accuracy across confidence bins; lower is better. Maximum Calibration Error (MCE) : worst single confidence-bin gap; lower is better. Clustering distance : raw disagreement rate between runs, used for similarity trees rather than leaderboard ranking. Cohen’s kappa : accuracy corrected for chance agreement given the label distribution; 1 = perfect agreement, 0 = chance-level, <0 = worse than chance. Confusion matrix : where the model systematically confuses one label for another. Cross-model α : how similarly different models classify the same task variant. Macro precision / recall / F1 : class-balanced averages of the per-label scores, so rare labels count equally with frequent ones. Repeat α : stability of the same model across repeated runs on the same task variant. , calibration, token usage, estimated prices and repeated-run or cross-model agreement in a number of visualizations: grouped chart, scatterplot, sortable table, radar graph, agreement tree and a customizable leaderboard. Links from individual run’s details connect summary values to metric files and, where published, prediction files and logs.
blocks.zh: 浏览器仪表板被设计为个人研究人员在当地用于分析他们的运行或在线,公开分享互动结果. 它可以加载一个本地的度量衡文件夹或服务器收藏和过滤器,按任务,模型,标记和时间运行. 其观点揭露了精确度和其他标签度量衡 7 7 度量衡定义:精确度:精确率,即预测标签=金标签的示例份额. Brier 得分 : 信心和正确性之间的平方差错; 下方更好. 预期校准错误(欧洲经委会): 说明的信任与整个信任箱的实际准确性之间的平均差距;较低的情况更好。 最大校准错误( MCE) : 最糟糕的单一信任-bin差距;较低更好。 集群距离 : 运行之间原始的分歧率,用于相似性树而非领导板排名. Cohen的kappa : 准确校正标签分发的机会协议; 1 = 完美协议, 0 = 机会级, <0 = 不如机会级. 混沌矩阵 :即模型系统地将一个标签混为一谈. Cross-model α:相似的模型如何将同一个任务变体分类. 宏精度 / recept / F1 : 每个标签分数的类均匀平均值,因此罕见的标签与频繁的标签数相等. 重复 α : 同一模型的稳定性贯穿于同一任务变体上。 校准、符号使用、估计价格以及一些可视化的重复运行或跨模式协议:分组图、分散图、可分类表、雷达图、协议树和一个可定制的标头板。 个人运行细节的链接将汇总值连接到度量文件,并在发布时连接到预测文件和日志.

blocks.en: Grouped summaries require explicit interpretation. In the default model grouping, repeated runs are averaged within a task and the task means are then averaged. Models evaluated on different task sets therefore have different denominators. The customizable leaderboard can require wha common set of tasks and explicit weights, which makes its composite score more interpretable, but comparable task names alone do not automatically establish identical prompts, validators or dataset versions, the user can control for this using tags.
blocks.zh: 分组摘要需要明确解释。 在默认模式分组中,重复运行在任务内进行平均,然后进行平均任务手段. 因此,在不同任务组合上评价的模式具有不同的分母。 可自定义的领导板可以要求wh a 常见的一组任务和明确的权重,这使得其复合得分更便于解释,但可比较的任务名称本身并不自动建立相同的提示,验证器或数据集版本,用户可以使用标记来控制这一点.

The implementation distinguishes repeated runs of the same provider--model combination from agreement between different models. Cross-model summaries can use the latest run or the run with the highest accuracy. 8 8 8 Note that this can overstate expected performance for frequent re-runs.
blocks.zh: 协议是根据ID一致的预测计算的,任务指纹包含输入字段和参考标签. 实施工作将同一供应商-模式组合的重复运行与不同模式之间的协议区分开来。 跨模型摘要可以使用最精确的最新运行或运行. 8 8 8 注意这可以高估频繁重跑的预期性能.

blocks.en: 4 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4个数据集

blocks.en: The datasets were selected pragmatically on the basis of three criteria: 1. They involved linguistic annotation tasks that were not reliably addressed by conventional NLP tools. 2. The data and their reference annotations were available to the authors, often through their own research. 3. The authors had sufficient knowledge of the annotation procedures to formulate prompts similar to instructions for human annotators and to analyze the annotations produced by dhAIBench .
blocks.zh: 数据集是根据以下三个标准实际选定的: 1. 它们涉及语言注释工作,而传统的NLP工具无法可靠地处理。 2. 数据及其参考说明往往通过作者自己的研究提供给作者。 3. 提交人对注释程序有充分的了解,可以提出类似于人类注释员说明的提示,并分析DhAI Bench编写的说明。

blocks.en: The prompts were formulated in natural language and ranged from very short and simple (for the Sentiment analysis task 9 9 9 Prompt: “You will analyze an excerpt representing an online movie review and decide whether the excerpt represents a positive or a negative sentiment of the reviewer towards the movie. In case of a positive sentiment, return ‘positive’, in case of a negative sentiment, return ‘negative’.” ) to long and complex – the LModE PoS tagging task prompt included the complete CLAWS tagset and a large number of examples while the Discourse-pragmatice uses of like task prompt comprised of instructions for a hierarchical multi-step annotation process.
blocks.zh: 这些提示是用自然语言拟定的,内容非常简短(对于感知分析任务9 9 9 Expoint):“你将分析代表在线电影评论的节选,并决定节选代表评论员对电影的正面还是负面情绪。 在出现积极情绪时,如果出现消极情绪,返回“积极”状态,返回“消极”状态。 ”长而复杂 — — LModE PoS标记任务即刻包含完整的CLAWS标记集和大量实例,而Discour-progmatic对类似任务即刻的使用则包含分级多步骤注释进程的指示。

blocks.en: 4.1 T1: Discourse-pragmatic uses of like
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 T1: 诸如此类的演讲和表演用途

blocks.en: The dataset contains 115 contextualized instances of like , corresponding to the inter-rater validation sample in Raušová’s ( 2026 ) Discourse-pragmatic like: An empirically grounded functional taxonomy . The examples originate from two corpora of informal spoken British English: the demographically sampled component of the BNC1994 and the Spoken BNC2014. The sample was selected to cover the taxonomy’s functional distinctions and was annotated by two independent raters using a decision tree. Each benchmark item presents a target occurrence alongside its surrounding dialogue. Classification draws primarily on omissibility, syntactic position, and syntactic boundedness - that is, whether like is structurally associated with the material preceding or following it.
blocks.zh: 该数据集包含115个背景化的类似案例,对应Raušovás(2026年)的校对者间验证样本:实证基础的功能分类学。 例子来源于两个非正式的英式英语集成体:BNC1994和Spoken BNC2014的人口抽样部分. 样本的选取是为了涵盖分类学的功能区别,由两个使用决策树的独立测算员作注释. 每个基准项目在其周围的对话中都列出一个目标。 分类主要参考了可视性、综合位置和协同界限,即,无论是在结构上还是在其之后,都与材料有关。

blocks.en: The benchmark distinguishes four discourse-pragmatic functions. Discourse markers (40 instances) are syntactically unbound and organize discourse or manage disfluency, as in “Board games today are insane like I've my friends bought me […]”. Clause-medial pragmatic markers (25 instances) scope forward over following material, highlighting information or signaling that its interpretation requires enrichment or loosening: “my friends have got like nose rings and stuff”. Clause-final pragmatic markers (25 instances) scope backward, conveying emphasis, qualifying preceding material, or inviting confirmation, as in “I’m as stubborn, stubborn as a mule like .” Quotative markers (20 instances) introduce reported speech, thoughts, feelings, or attitudes, commonly within be like : “the guy was like no no no you paid this village …”. These examples are drawn from the dataset, with target occurrences italicized.
blocks.zh: 该基准区分了四种语句-语句功能. 演讲标记(40例)在战术上是没有约束的,组织谈话或管理不顺,如“今天的博弈像我的朋友给我买的一样疯狂[......]”。 条款-实用标记(25个实例)在以下材料上延伸范围,突出信息或表明其解释需要丰富或放松:“我的朋友有鼻环之类的东西”。 条款-最终的务实标记(25例 ) , 向后延伸, 传达重点, 限定之前的材料, 或邀请确认, 如“我像骡子一样固执。 批评标记(20例)引入了报道的言论、思想、感情或态度, 这些例子取自数据集,目标事件以斜体表示。

blocks.en: A fifth label, unclassified (5 instances), covers propositional uses outside the discourse-pragmatic taxonomy, such as the verb in “I don’t really like skype.” Although the paper’s taxonomy includes three hierarchical levels, the benchmark retains only the four main discourse-pragmatic categories and this propositional contrast class. The task consequently evaluates broad functional classification of like in conversational context, rather than the finer distinctions among its pragmatic subfunctions.
blocks.zh: 第五个标签,未分类(5例 ) , 涵盖话语分类法以外的命题用途,例如“我真的不喜欢Skype”中的动词。 虽然论文的分类学包括三个层次,但基准只保留了四个主要论述-理论类和这个命题对比类. 因此,这项任务评估了在对话背景下对相似性的广泛功能分类,而不是其实用亚功能之间的细微区别。

blocks.en: 4.2 T2: Adverbial -ing clauses
blocks.zh: 4.2 T2:附带条款

blocks.en: The ADV-ing dataset contains 318 manually identified English adverbial -ing clauses adapted from Lávička’s ( 2024 ) thesis Adverbial -ing Clauses in Newswriting: A Diachronic Comparison . The source material comprises 108 Guardian news reports on politics and current affairs, drawn from printed newspapers published in 1953 and online articles published in 2023. The dataset includes 126 instances from the earlier period and 192 from the later period.
blocks.zh: ADV-ing数据集包含318个手动识别的英语旁听条款-根据Lávička(2024年)论文Adverbial-ing条款在Newswriting: A Diachronic Compareting 中改编. 来源材料包括108份卫报关于政治和时事的新闻报道,摘自1953年出版的印刷报纸和2023年出版的在线文章. 数据集包括前期的126例和后期的192例。

blocks.en: The annotation scheme distinguishes three construction types. Free adjuncts (FA; 216 instances) lack an overt subject, typically sharing their understood subject with the matrix clause, as in “ Speaking to ABC News , the governor said search-and-rescue efforts were ongoing.” and may also be introduced by an optional conjunction such as while . Adverbial verbal gerunds (AVG; 81 instances) are governed by an obligatory preposition, as in “A bee-keeper restored order by removing the jacket, complete with swarm, in a sack .” Absolute constructions (AC; 21 instances) have their own overt subject and may be introduced by with , as in “Areas along the Emilia-Romagna coastlines were also affected by the floods, with debris washing up on beaches .” These examples are drawn from the dataset, with the target constructions italicized.
blocks.zh: 注释方案区分了三种建筑类型。 免费附赠(FA;216例)缺乏一个公开的主题,通常与矩阵条款分享其理解的主题,例如,在“ABC新闻”中,州长说搜救工作正在进行中。” 绝对建筑(AC; 21个案例)有它们自己的公开主题,并且可以由它们引入,如“艾米利亚-罗马纳海岸线沿线地区也受到洪水影响,海滩上垃圾被冲洗 ” 。 这些例子来自数据集,目标构造为斜体化.

blocks.en: 4.3 T3: Normalization of Early Modern English printed text
blocks.zh: 4.3 T3: 早期现代英文印刷文本的正常化

blocks.en: The dataset contains 7,489 token-level instances adapted from Titlbachová’s ( 2025 ) thesis, Normalization of non-standardized varieties of Early Modern English using AI language models . Its 15 text samples follow a sampling framework combining three periods: 1500–1550, 1550–1600, and 1600–1650, with five genres: literary, religious, administrative, and educational texts, and personal correspondence. One text represents each period–genre combination, with excerpts of approximately 500 words. Printed texts were selected through the Universal Short Title Catalogue and obtained from the Early Print Library ; correspondence comes from the Parsed Corpus of Early English Correspondence . Each benchmark item supplies an original token, surrounding context, source metadata (title, author publication date), and a manually standardized reference form.
blocks.zh: 该数据集包含7,489个从Titlbachovs(2025年)论文改编的符号级实例,使用AI语言模型实现早期现代英语非标准化品种的正常化. 它的15个文本样本遵循一个抽样框架,将3个时期结合起来:1500–150,1550–160,1600–1650,以及5个流派:文学,宗教,行政和教育文本,以及个人信件. 一个文本代表每个时期-流派组合,节选约500字. 印刷文本通过世界短标题目录选取,并来自早期印刷库;信件来自早期英语信件的解析公司。 每个基准项目提供原始符号、周围环境、源元数据(标题、作者出版日期)和手动标准化的参考表。

blocks.en: The annotation task is spelling normalization, it regularizes historical orthography as in fallynge > falling , expands abbreviations such as yᵉ > the , but preserves word order and morphology (e.g. hath is retained), prohibits adding, deleting or replacing words (e.g. obsolete vocabulary with modern synonyms) and retains punctuation and capitalization.
blocks.zh: 注释任务为拼写正常化,将历史正字法规范化,如fallynge > falling ,扩展缩写如you > the,但保留单词顺序和形态(如已保留),禁止添加,删除或替换单词(如与现代同义词的过时词汇),并保留标点和资本化.

blocks.en: The dataset includes both forms requiring normalization and forms retained unchanged: 1,941 source–reference pairs differ, while 5,548 are identical. Successful normalization consequently requires deciding when intervention is appropriate as well as selecting the correct spelling.
blocks.zh: 数据集既包括需要正常化的表格,又保留不变的表格:1,941个来源参考对,5,548个相同。 因此,成功的正常化需要决定何时进行干预是适当的,以及选择正确的拼法。

blocks.en: 4.4 T4: Error-correction of prepositions in learners’ language
blocks.zh: 4.4 T4: 学习者语言中前置位置的错误校正

blocks.en: The dataset was compiled by Todorova ( 2023 ) to investigate the use of the prepositions in , on and at by advanced learners of English with Spanish as their L1. The data was drawn from the Spanish subcorpus of the Louvain International Database of Spoken English Interlanguage ( Gilquin et al. 2010 ) , which comprises 50 orthographically transcribed interviews consisting of a monologue, an informal conversation and a picture-description task.
blocks.zh: 数据集由Todorova(2023年)汇编,以调查以西班牙语为L1的英语高级学习者在 、 和 和 上使用预设位置的情况。 数据取自Louvain英语国际数据库的西班牙子公司(Gilquin等人,2010年),该数据库包含50个正文转录访谈,包括独白、非正式谈话和图片描述任务。

blocks.en: The dataset contains 1,284 instances of the target prepositions presented in their immediate context. Each instance is annotated for accuracy, and a correction is provided where the preposition use was judged to be erroneous.
blocks.zh: 数据集包含1 284个近期目标预置实例。 每个实例都附有说明,说明准确性,如果预置用途被判定错误,则作出更正。

blocks.en: 4.5 T5: Part-of-speech tagging of Late Modern English correspondence
blocks.zh: 4.5 T5: 现代英语晚期通信的语音标记

blocks.en: The LModE POS dataset contains 5,681 annotated tokens drawn from the 15-letter test sample described by Saario-Ramsay et al. in My grat destress – POS tagging 18th-century English letters ( Saario-Ramsay et al. n.d. ) . The letters originate from the Corpus of Early English Correspondence Extension (CEECE) and span 1690–1784, representing male and female writers across social ranks, from paupers to the nobility. The material retains historical spelling and capitalization, including forms such as grat (‘great’) and destress (‘distress’).
blocks.zh: LModE POS数据集包含从Saario-Ramsay等人描述的15个字母测试样本中抽取的5,681个注解符号. 校对:Soup 这些信件来自早期英语函授扩展公司(CEECE),从1690年到1784年,代表社会各阶层的男女作家,从穷人到贵族。 材料保留了历史的拼写和资本化,包括诸如grat( " great " )和desstress( " distress " )等形式。

blocks.en: The annotation follows the fine-grained CLAWS7 scheme, with 139 distinct reference labels represented in the supplied dataset, including punctuation and multiword-expression tags. The scheme distinguishes grammatical categories together with morphological and functional properties. For example, letter receives NN1 (singular common noun), whereas thoughts receives NN2 (plural common noun); I is PPIS1 (first-person singular subject pronoun), whereas me is PPIO1 (the corresponding object pronoun). Verbal distinctions include VVD for lexical past-tense forms such as gave , VVN for past participles such as stolen , and VVI for infinitives such as tell . Separate tag families distinguish forms of be , have , and do from other verbs.
blocks.zh: 注释遵循精细的CLAWS7方案,在所提供的数据集中有139个不同的参考标签,包括标注和多字表达标记. 本方案将语法分类与形态学和功能性区分开来. 例如,字母接收NN1(单人普通名词),而思考接收NN2(平面普通名词);我是PPIS1(第一人称单人主题代词),而我是PPIO1(对应对象代词). 口头上的区别包括:对过去语法的VVD,例如给定的;对过去语法的VVN,例如被盗的;对无限语法的VVI,例如告诉。 分离的标记家族将形式区分为,有,并与其他动词区分开来.

blocks.en: Multiword expressions receive ditto tags, which combine a grammatical category with numeric suffixes identifying the expression’s length and each component’s position. Thus, at least is annotated at_RR21 least_RR22, treating the two words jointly as an adverb, while so that receives so_CS21 that_CS22, marking a subordinating conjunction. This convention also accommodates historically separate spellings, such as after_RT21 words_RT22 (‘afterwards’). Punctuation marks are included as classification targets and generally receive the mark itself as their label. The underlying gold standard covers both tokenization and tagging: annotations were prepared by one annotator, checked by a second, and unclear cases resolved jointly.
blocks.zh: 多字表达式得到ditto标记,将语法分类和数字后缀结合起来,识别表达式的长度和每个组件的位置. 因此,至少被注解为_RR21 least_RR22,将这两个单词作为副词一并处理,而这样就收到 so_CS21 即_CS22,表示子坐标连接. 该公约还允许历史上分开的拼写,例如,在_RT21 字之后的_RT22( " 后 " )。 标注标记列为分类目标,一般会作为标签接收标记本身. 基本的金本位标准包括标注和标记:说明由一名注释员编写,经第二名核对,不明确的案件共同解决。

blocks.en: 4.6 T6: Semantic disambiguation of Middle English nouns
blocks.zh: 4.6 T6:中英名词的语义疏解

blocks.en: The dataset originates in Tichý and Přečková’s ( n.d. ) research on Morphological countability in Middle English. It is an export of all potential spelling variants of four nouns: loaf, man, meat and son from The Penn-Helsinki Parsed Corpus of Middle English , second edition (PPCME2). Since Middle English spelling is highly varied and the corpus is not lemmatized, finding specific lexical items is difficult, because tokens can be formally highly ambiguous. For example, lemma loaf ( lof ) can appear in forms like loues or lof which are in turn potential spelling of lemmas love and leaf respectively.
blocks.zh: 该数据集起源于Tichý和Přečková’s(n.d.)关于中英语的摩尔法可计数性的研究. 它出口了四种名词的所有潜在拼写变体:loaf, man, meat and son, from The Penn-Helsinki Parsed Corpus of Middle English, 第二版(PPCME2). 由于中英文拼写形式差异很大,而且本体没有被拼写,因此很难找到具体的词典项目,因为符号在形式上可能非常模糊. 例如,lemma loaf(lof)可以以loes或lof等形式出现,而loes或lof则分别是lemma 爱和叶的潜在拼写.

blocks.en: The models were tasked with disambiguating the instances by annotating all actual occurrences of the four target words with the corresponding lemma or returning other , in case the instance represent a different lexical item.
blocks.zh: 这些模型的任务是通过将四个目标词的所有实际发生情况与相应的lemma进行注释或返回其他情况来混淆这些例子,以防这种情况代表了不同的语法项目。

blocks.en: The input data also supplied the model with text metadata like name of the text, Middle English dialect, genre and dating to inform the model’s decision.
blocks.zh: 输入数据还为模型提供了文本名称、中英文方言、流派和日期等文字元数据,以通报模型的决定。

blocks.en: 4.7 T7: Lemmatization of Old English
blocks.zh: 4.7 (中文(简体) ). T7:旧英语的Lemmatization

blocks.en: This dataset was benchmarked in partnership with Faulkner & Magnanti ( 2027 ) in view of producing a new lemmatized Old English corpus. It contains 2,846 tokens of OE and Latin 10 10 10 Latin tokens are ignored and labeled as foreign_word. from Ælfric’s Catholic Homilies exported with their immediate context 11 11 11 50 tokens left & right. from The Lemmatized York-Helsinki Parsed Corpus of Old English Prose , Beta version 12 ( Taylor et al. 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 这套数据集与Faulkner & Magnanti(2027年)合作制定基准,以编制新的Lemmatized Old English教程。 它包含2,846个OE和拉丁文10个拉丁文10个符号被忽略并标注为外语_word. from Qölfric的天主教Homilies出口,其直接上下文 11 11 11 50个符号左侧和右侧. 译自《Lemmatized York-Helsinki Parsed Corpus of Old English Prose》,第12版(泰勒等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: The task is contextual lemmatization: assigning the appropriate OE lexical headword to a form encountered in running text. It groups inflectional and orthographic variants under shared lemmas e.g. com > cuman , bocum > boc , þisum > þes and regularizes orthographic variation, as in syþþan > siþþan . Context determines the appropriate analysis of ambiguous forms: for example, þa receives either se when functioning as a demonstrative or þa in temporal uses. The PoS and some morphological information present in the original corpus are also supplied to the model.
blocks.zh: 任务为上下文语法化:为运行文本时遇到的形式指定适当的 OE 词汇头词。 它在共享的lemmas下,如com > cuman,bocum > boc, þsum > 下,将功能变体和正体变体分组. 如syþþan > siþþan中,正字形变异的正字化. 上下文决定了对模棱两可形式进行的适当分析:例如,“a”在作为示范物发挥作用时得到“a”或“a”在时间使用时得到“a”。 原体中的PoS和一些形态学信息也提供给模型.

blocks.en: This annotation task makes use of a validator (see section 3.1.2 ), which checks each predicted lemma against a reference lexicon derived from the Bosworth-Toller Anglo-Saxon Dictionary Online ( Tichý and Roček 2024 ) . Predictions are matched against the dictionary headwords filtered by the corresponding PoS information, exact matches including those with pre-defined orthographic equivalents (e.g., upper/lowercase, þ/ð) are accepted and the validator stops. Otherwise, near-match candidate lemmas are ranked by a weighted edit distance that accommodates OE spelling variation, including vowel alternations, doubled letters, final -e , and the ge- prefix. The validator requests a revised prediction using the closest candidates (by default, up to 30 within a distance of 1.25). This procedure helps to enforce lexical compatibility and to lower hallucination but does not establish contextual correctness (only dictionary lemmas are allowed into the output, but they may not necessarily be the correct lemmas).
blocks.zh: 这一注释任务使用一个验证符(见第3.1.2节),该验证符对照博斯沃思-托勒盎格鲁-撒克逊词典在线(Tichý和Roček 2024)衍生的参考词典检查每个预测的lemma. 预测值与由对应的PoS信息过滤的词典头词相匹配,精确匹配值,包括预定义的正体等效值(如上/小写, /ð)被接受,验证符停止. 否则,接近匹配的候选lemma会按照一个可容纳OE拼音变异的加权编辑距离进行排序,包括元音交替,双倍字母,最终-e,以及ge前缀. 验证人要求使用最接近的候选人进行订正预测(默认情况下,在1.25的距离内最多30人)。 这个程序有助于执行词典兼容性,降低幻觉,但并不建立上下文正确性(只允许词典lemma进入输出,但不一定是正确的lemma).

blocks.en: 4.8 T8: Number of Old English nouns
blocks.zh: 4.8 T8:旧英语名词数

blocks.en: The Old English nouns show a large degree of syncretism in their endings (not to mention their spelling variation) which makes it difficult to recognize their morphological categories based on the form of the ending alone. This dataset represents an export from The York-Toronto-Helsinki Parsed Corpus of Old English Prose (YCOE) of forms of twelve nominal lemmas 12 12 12 ale, book, brother, death, flesh, hand, might, milk, name, sin, water and wood. that are, due to the syncretism, ambiguous in their number. For example, handa can be either genitive/dative sg. or nominative/accusative/genitive plural.
blocks.zh: 古英语名词在结尾中表现出了很大程度的同步性(更不用提其拼写变异),这使得很难根据单词结尾的形式来识别其形态分类. 这个数据集代表了旧英语Prose(Yoork-Toronto-Helsinki Parsed Corpus of Old English Prose(YCOE))出口的十二种名义lemma 12 12 12 ale,书,兄弟,死亡,肉,手,可能,牛奶,名字,罪恶,水和木. 即,由于同步性,它们的数目模糊不清。 例如,handa可以是genitive/dative sg.,也可以是Nominative/accusative/genitive复数.

blocks.en: For Tichý’s and Ripl’s ( n.d. ) research on Countability in Old English, we have used the models no annotate instances of these nouns as either singular or plural and in addition to the forms and their immediate context, we have provided the models with the information on case, as annotated in the corpus.
blocks.zh: 对于Tichý’s和Ripl(n.d.)关于旧英语中的可计数性的研究,我们使用这些名词的无注释实例模型作为单数或复数,除了表格及其直接背景之外,我们还向模型提供了有关案件的信息,如书目中注解的那样。

blocks.en: 4.9 T9: Sentiment analysis of the Movie Review Data
blocks.zh: 4.9 (中文(简体) ). T9:电影评论数据的感知分析

blocks.en: The sentence polarity dataset (commonly the Pang & Lee sentence polarity dataset) is a binary sentiment-classification corpus of English movie-review snippets drawn from Rotten Tomatoes. It contains 10,662 snippets in total, evenly balanced into 5,331 positive and 5,331 negative examples, provided as two plain-text files (rt-polarity.pos and rt-polarity.neg) with one snippet per line. Each snippet is roughly a single sentence and all text is lower-cased. Labels were assigned automatically from the review’s Rotten Tomatoes rating: snippets from reviews marked “fresh” are treated as positive and those marked “rotten” as negative. The dataset was introduced by Pang and Lee ( 2005 ) and has become a standard benchmark for
blocks.zh: 句子极性数据集(通常为Pang & Lee句子极性数据集)是英国电影评论片段从罗腾番茄中抽取的二进制情绪分类器. 它包含总共10,662个片段,均匀平衡为5,331个正和5,331个负例,作为两个纯文本文件(rt-polarity.pos和rt-polarity.neg)提供,每行有1个片段. 每个片段大致是一个单句,所有文字都是小写. 标签自动从审查的Rotten番茄分级中划出:以 " 新鲜 " 为标记的审查片段被视为正面,以 " rotten " 为负面。 数据集由Pang和Lee (2005年)引入,并已成为标准基准。

blocks.en: When used with their default settings, LLMs are notoriously stochastic. The degree of repeatability and therefore to a degree reproducibility can be observed by analyzing the agreement between runs of the same model on the same task, calculated as pairwise Cohen’s κ and by comparing Accuracy and Macro F1 of those runs. Gemini-3.1-Flash-lite and Kimi-k3 show better repeatability than GLM-5.1/3 or Qwen-3.8 27B (Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh: 当使用它们的默认设置时, LLMs 臭名昭著的有风格. 通过分析同一模型运行在同一任务上的一致,即按照Cohen的双向单数计算,并通过比较这些运行的精确度和Macro F1,可以观察到可重复性的程度,从而达到可复制性的程度。 双子座-3.1-Flash-lite和Kimi-k3显示的重现性优于GLM-5.1/3或Quen-3.8 27B(图10).

blocks.en: One of the main model parameters influencing randomness of predicted tokens and therefore model stochasticity is temperature. We tested 6 temperature levels (0, 0.5, 0.8, 1, 1.5 and 2) on three models, see Figure 11 . Across the three models, higher temperatures generally reduced repeatability, although accuracy and Macro F1 did not decline uniformly. DeepSeek-V4 Pro Thinking improved modestly from temperature 0 to 1, reaching median accuracy of 82.6% and Macro F1 of 81.4%, while κ remained around 0.77–0.80; at its maximum temperature of 1.5, however, both runs failed entirely, reducing all three measures to zero. GLM-5.1 maintained comparatively high accuracy (86–88%), Macro F1 (83–88%) and κ (0.89–0.92) through temperature 1, but at 1.5 its κ fell to 0.74, quality declined modestly, and 28 of 345 responses failed. Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite was perfectly repeatable at temperatures 0 and 0.5 (κ = 1), despite lower prediction quality; accuracy and Macro F1 declined slightly and then remained broadly stable, while κ fell to 0.88 at temperature 2, with only one failed response. The failed runs were largely due to the models’ inability to form valid JSONs at higher temperatures. The provider defaults, 0.8 for DeepSeek and GLM, and 1 for Gemini, therefore, lie within relatively stable operating ranges, but were not uniformly the best-performing settings in these runs.
blocks.zh: 影响预测符随机性的主要模型参数之一,因此模型的色谱性是温度. 我们在三个模型上测试了6个温度水平(0、0.5、0.8、1、1.5和2),见图11。 在整个三种模型中,较高的温度一般降低了可重复性,尽管精确度和Macro F1并没有统一下降. 深层搜索- V4 Pro 认为从0到1的温度略有改善,达到82.6%的中位精度和81.4%的Macro F1,而雄性在0.77-0.80左右;然而,在1.5的最高温度下,两者都完全失败,所有三种度量都降到了零。 GLM-5.1通过温度1保持相对较高的精度(86–88 %),Macro F1(83–88 %)和University(9–0.92美元),但以1.5的精度下降到0.74,质量略有下降,345个回复中有28个失败. 双子座-3.1 Flash-Lite在0和0.5(ob = 1)温度下完全可以重复,尽管预测质量较低;精度和Macro F1稍有下降,然后大致保持稳定,而在2温度下ob ob 则降至0.88,只有一个失败的响应. 运行失败主要是由于模型在较高温度下无法形成有效的JSONs。 因此,供应商默认,DeepSeek和GLM为0.8,双子座为1,处于相对稳定的运行范围,但并不是这些运行中业绩最佳的设置。

blocks.en: Figure 11: The influence of temperature in T1 on Cohen’s κ (agreement), Accuracy and Macro F1.
blocks.zh: 图11:T1中的温度对科恩的(对称),精确度和宏F1的影响.

blocks.en: A particularly common worry when using LLMs for annotations are hallucinations. These are relatively easy to avoid with a small tagset, but in case of a large pool of permissible annotation, dhAIBench delegates the task to external validators (see section 3.1.2 ). We have tested the validator on the OE lemmatization task, given the tag set comprises of all OE dictionary headwords, and we compared each run’s first pre-validator prediction with its final output. Figure 12 shows that validator feedback improved accuracy and Macro F1 in all 13 included Old English lemmatization runs, with median gains of 6.54 and 20.47 percentage points, respectively. Qwen3.8 27B showed the largest improvements (+12.65 points in accuracy and +29.81 in Macro F1), although its final scores remained below those of the other models; Gemini-3 Flash Preview achieved the highest final accuracy (98.74%) and Macro F1 (92.70%). Across 36,998 predictions, 3,418 received an intervention: 2,855 involved retries and 563 normalizations alone. Interventions corrected 2,715 initially wrong predictions but changed 220 correct predictions to incorrect ones; normalization alone was particularly successful, correcting 560 cases and harming only one. Macro F1 gains were consistently larger than accuracy gains, partly because correcting invented lemmas also removed spurious predicted classes.
blocks.zh: 使用LLMS做说明时特别常见的担忧是幻觉. 使用一个小的标记集比较容易避免,但如果有大量允许的说明,DhAI Bench将任务交给外部验证人(见第3.1.2节)。 我们测试了 OE lemmatization 任务上的验证器, 因为标记集包含 OE 词典的所有头词, 我们比较了每个运行的第一个前验证器预测及其最终输出. 图12显示,验证器反馈的准确性提高,所有13项中的Macro F1包括了旧英语的lemmatization运行,中间增益分别为6.54和20.47个百分点. Quen3.8 27B显示的改进最大(精确度+12.65分,Macro F1为+29.81分),尽管其最终分数仍然低于其他模型;双子座-3闪光预览实现最高最终精度(98.74%)和Macro F1(92.70%). 在36 998项预测中,3 418项得到干预:2 855项涉及复试,563项正常化。 干预措施纠正了2 715个最初错误的预测,但将220个正确的预测改为错误的预测;仅正常化就特别成功,纠正了560个案例,只伤害了一个案例。 宏观F1的增益始终大于精度增益,部分原因是,纠正发明的lemma也消除了虚假的预测类.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Validator in T7: quality gains in Accuracy and Macro F1 and intervention types.
blocks.zh: 图12 T7中的验证器:精度和宏F1的质量增益以及干预类型.

blocks.en: 5.2 Results of individual tasks
blocks.zh: 5.2 各项任务的结果

blocks.en: The metrics in 5.1 show how well the models perform, but not where and why they fail. This section therefore offers a qualitative and comparative look at selected tasks, based on an inspection of the mismatches between model predictions and the reference annotations. The aim is not a systematic error analysis but to complement the quantitative results and give the reader a sense of where the inaccuracies typically arise.
blocks.zh: 5.1中的衡量标准显示模型表现如何,但没有显示它们在哪里和为什么失败。 因此,本节根据对模型预测和参考说明之间不匹配情况的检查,对选定的任务进行定性和比较。 目的不是系统的错误分析,而是补充量化结果,使读者了解通常发生的不准确之处。

blocks.en: 5.2.1 T1: Discourse-pragmatic uses of like
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 T1: 类似语言的演讲和演示用途

blocks.en: The top results for this task were around 95% for both Accuracy and Macro F1. This is lower than the 98% reported by Raušová (by private communication) for her expert human annotators, but higher than the 84.5% Accuracy reported by Popescu-Belis & Zufferey ( 2011 ) , who used decision trees to automate the binary annotation discourse-marker/other. In our case, the problems mostly concentrated in misidentification of Discourse Markers as clause-medial or clause-final markers or with misidentification of clause-final as clause-medial markers. This is similar across all models including those with significantly worse results overall. This seems to be largely due to irregular punctuation and the disconnected nature of the transcript where speakers talk over each other. This makes it difficult for the model to identify clause boundaries and consequently choose the wrong annotation but could possibly be alleviated by alleviated by larger context and better instructions for parsing this type of transcript.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的最高成果是准确性和宏观F1的95%。 这低于Raušová(通过私人通信)为她的专家人类注释员报告的98%,但高于Popescu-Belis & Zuffrey(2011年)报告的84.5%准确度,后者利用决策树将二进制注释-标记符/其他注释自动化. 在我们的情况中,问题主要集中于将演讲标记误认为条款-中间或条款-最后标记,或将条款-最后误认为条款-中间标记。 在所有模式中,包括总体结果严重差的模式中,情况都类似。 这似乎主要是由于发言者相互交谈的笔录不规则的标语和脱节的性质。 这使模型难以确定条款界限,从而选择错误的注释,但可以通过更大的上下文和更好的解析这类笔录的指示加以缓解。

blocks.en: 5.2.2 T2: Adverbial -ing clauses
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 T2:附带条款

blocks.en: The best results for this task reached around 98% in Accuracy and Macro F1, i.e. only 6 misclassifications out of 318 items for the best run (see the confusion matrix in Figure 13 , which is automatically created for every run).
blocks.zh: 这项工作的最佳结果在精确度和Macro F1中达到98%左右,即318项中只有6项分类错误,用于最佳运行(见图13中的混淆矩阵,每一次运行都会自动创建).

blocks.en: Figure 13: The confusion matrix for the top run of T2 using gemini-3-flash-preview in counts and percentages.
blocks.zh: 图13:T2顶端运行的混淆矩阵,使用计数和百分比的Gemini-3-flash-preview.

blocks.en: Since even small models like qwen3.8-27b scored above 90%, the test is largely saturated. The errors were mostly adverbial verbal gerunds (AVG) classified as free adjuncts (FA) or unclassified, and this was common for all the models. While we do not have comparable data for human or automatic annotators, we have discovered 2 misclassifications and 15 potentially ambiguous instances among our gold labels, i.e. the top run is comparable to an expert human annotator.
blocks.zh: 由于Qwen3.8-27b等小型模型的得分都高于90%,因此测试基本都是饱和的. 错误大多是被归类为自由辅音(FA)或未分类的旁听语音(AVG),这在所有模型中都是常见的. 虽然我们没有人类或自动注释员的可比数据,但我们在我们的金牌上发现了2个错误的分类和15个可能模糊的事例,即顶级运行可与专家人类注释员相比。

blocks.en: 5.2.3 T3: Normalization of Early Modern English printed text
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 T3: 早期现代英文印刷文本的正常化

blocks.en: Accuracy across the models on the EModE normalization task was generally above 97%, with glm-5.2 achieving the best performance (97.98%) and gpt-oss-120b:free the worst (32.35%). The poor performance of gpt-oss-120b:free was due to the format of its output. The prediction column contained classification labels, such as normalization , no_change , and unclassified , rather than the actual normalized word forms. In some cases, the expected forms appeared only in the model's explanations, not in the structured output. This made it impossible to directly evaluate the model's spelling normalization accuracy automatically.
blocks.zh: EModE正常化任务各模型的精确度一般高于97%,glm-5.2达到最佳性能(97.98%)和gpt-oss-120b:最差(32.35%)。 gpt-oss-120b:free的不良性能是由于其输出格式所致. 预测栏中包含分类标签,如正常化、无更改和未分类,而不是实际正常化的字表。 在某些情况下,预期的表格只出现在模型的解释中,而不是结构化的产出中. 这使得无法自动直接评价模型的拼写正常化精度.

blocks.en: An analysis of the mismatches in the best-performing run revealed that, despite its generally high accuracy, the model did not consistently follow certain instructions in the prompt. One recurring issue was the failure to follow Rule 7, which states that proper names should not be normalized or changed. For example, the model changed Iuppyter to Jupiter . Although the resulting spelling is correct in modern English, the change violates the explicit instruction to preserve proper names. Problems also occurred with Latin expressions, apostrophes, and corrupted characters. Conversely, one example of a prediction that was marked as incorrect but may actually be acceptable is oft , which was standardized to often in the truth column. However, oft is also a legitimate English variant, has its own entry in the OED, and is closer to the original form. Another ambiguous case involves words that can be normalized in more than one way. For example, Gayle could potentially be normalized to either gaol or jail . Both forms are valid, although each is supported by a slightly different rationale.
blocks.zh: 对最佳运行中不匹配情况的分析显示,尽管该模型的准确度一般很高,但它在即时操作中并没有一贯遵循某些指示. 一个反复出现的问题是没有遵守规则第7条,该条规定,适当名称不应正常化或更改。 例如,模型将Iuppyter改为木星. 虽然由此产生的拼写在现代英语中是正确的,但修改违反了保留正名的明确指示. 拉丁语表达式,aposrophes,以及腐朽的人物也出现了问题. 相反,一个被标记为不正确但实际上可能可以接受的预测的例子是自然的,这在真理栏中经常被标准化。 然而,ot也是一种合法的英语变体,在OED中有自己的条目,并且更接近原始形式. 另一个模棱两可的情况涉及可以不止一种方式实现正常化的词语。 例如,Gayle有可能正常化为Gaol或监狱。 这两种形式都是有效的,尽管每种形式都有稍有不同的理由支持.

blocks.en: When Hämäläinen et al. ( 2018 ) compared commonly used digital tools for text standardization with several alternative methods, including NMT, SMT, edit distance, and the rule-based finite-state transducer (VARD2), they concluded that NMT appeared to be the most effective individual method, achieving an accuracy of 46%. However, this result still falls considerably short of the performance achieved using LLMs.
blocks.zh: 当Hämäläinen等人(2018年)将常用的文本标准化数字工具与包括NMT,SMT,编辑距离,以及基于规则的有限态转录器(VARD2)等几种替代方法进行比较时,他们得出结论,NMT似乎是最有效的个人方法,实现了46%的准确性. 然而,这一结果仍然远远低于使用有限责任公司实现的业绩。

blocks.en: Similarly, texts from the Early Print Database, standardized using MorphAdorner software in combination with manual editing, were found to have a higher relative error rate (5.26) than those standardized using LLMs (0.62–1.87) ( Titlbachová 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 同样,早期印刷数据库的文本在使用MorphAdorner软件与人工编辑相结合的情况下标准化,其相对误差率(5.26)高于使用LLMs(0.62-1.87)的标准化文本(Titlbachová 2025)。

blocks.en: 5.2.4 T4: Error-correction of prepositions in learners’ language
blocks.zh: 5.2.4 T4: 学生语言中前置位置的校正错误

blocks.en: Accuracy across the models on the L2 prepositional use classification task ranged from 87.3% (jev-1.13.0) to 93.61% (gemini-4-argon). An analysis of the mismatches in the most successful run showed that, despite generally high accuracy, the model appeared to apply more inclusive criteria of acceptability than the human annotator. A particularly frequent source of disagreement involved prepositional uses that, although restricted to certain contexts, are attested and were therefore retained by the model as grammatically acceptable (e.g. ‘I have been in Belfast’; ‘buy something in McDonald’s’). However, the model also left some questionable cases uncorrected (e.g. ‘spend so much time in reading a novel’; ‘go in a pub’), while some of the annotator’s corrections reflected only differences between regional varieties of English or purely stylistic preferences (e.g. ‘a tour in the centre of Europe’ corrected to ‘a tour around the centre of Europe’). Only rarely did the disagreements result from an erroneous identification by either the annotator or the model. Rather, most of these discrepancies appear to stem from differences in the scope of acceptability applied by the model and the annotator as well as from the lack of detailed inclusion criteria in the original annotation. The remaining cases were peripheral and involved instances in which the model and the annotator proposed different but equally acceptable corrections or interpreted fragmented speech differently.
blocks.zh: L2预置使用分类任务的模型的精确度从87.3%(jev-1.13.0)到93.61%(gemini-4-argon)不等. 对最成功运行中不匹配情况的分析表明,尽管总体上精度很高,但该模型似乎比人类注释者适用更具包容性的可接受性标准。 一个特别频繁的分歧来源涉及前置用途,虽然这些用途仅限于某些情况,但已得到证实,因此被模型保留为语法上可接受的(例如,`我在贝尔法斯特 ' ;`购买麦当劳的东西 ' )。 然而,该模式也使一些有疑问的案件得不到纠正(例如, " 花这么多时间看小说 " ; " 去酒吧 " ),而一些注释员的更正只反映了英语或纯粹风格偏好的区域品种之间的差异(例如, " 在欧洲中心游览 " 更正为 " 环绕欧洲中心游览 " )。 分歧只是很少由注释者或模型错误地确定。 相反,这些差异大多似乎是由于模型和注释人适用的可接受性范围不同以及原注释中缺乏详细的列入标准。 其余案件是外围案件,涉及模型和注释员提出不同但同样可接受的更正或对零散言论作出不同解释的情况。

blocks.en: 5.2.5 T5: Part-of-speech tagging of Late Modern English correspondence
blocks.zh: 5.2.5 T5:现代英语晚期信件的语音标记

blocks.en: While the top Accuracy achieved for this task is around 97%, Macro F1 is only around 87%, which is primarily caused by a large number of relatively rare tags. This compares well with the previously reported 94.5% Accuracy ( Saario et al. 2021 ) for the Tagged Corpus of Early English Correspondence Extension achieved by first normalizing the corpus and then tagging it with CLAWS. The present dataset was shared by Saario-Ramsay et al. ( Saario-Ramsay et al. n.d. ) who achieved 94.28% using CLAWS and 92.26% using custom tuned smaller LLMs noting that ‘‘the best-performing model is the largest one, but the difference between 72B and 7B models is only 0.7pp’’. In our results, the difference between the top scoring gemini-3.5-flash and the smallest tested model qwen3.8-27b is 2.46%. Similar to Saario-Ramsay et al., the worst results were generally achieved for the letter written by a lower-class woman (PAUPER_11) 20 20 20 96.3% for the top run compared to 84.16% for the top LLM and 77.38% for CLAWS as reported by Saario-Ramsay et al. But note that for the best runs, the letters BLOMEFI and PINNEY actually achieved marginally worse results. and the difference between the best and worst per letter results was much smaller than the difference they reported for CLAWS indicating that the LLMs are particularly more capable compared to more traditional software like CLAWS when dealing with highly non-standard texts.
blocks.zh: 虽然这一任务达到的最高精确度约为97%,但Macro F1只有87%左右,这主要是大量相对罕见的标记造成的. 这与以前报告的94.5%的准确度(Saario 等人,2021年)相比是好的,因为早期英语函授扩展的标志性公司首先使文书正常化,然后将其贴上CLAWS的标签。 本数据集由Saario-Ramsay等人共享。 (Saario-Ramsay等人,注)他们使用CLAWS取得了94.28%的成绩,使用自定义调制的较小的LLMs取得了92.26%的成绩,指出最佳的模型是最大的模型,但72B和7B模型之间的差别只有0.7pp_。 在结果中,最高得分的格米尼-3.5-flash与测试最小的型号qwen3.8-27b的差别为2.46%. 与Saario-Ramsay等人的情况相似,对于一名下级妇女写的信(PAUPER_11)来说,结果普遍最差。 20 20 20 96.3%的上行成绩与Saario-Ramsay等人报告的CLAWS的84.16%和77.38%相比。 但请注意,就最好的情况而言,BLOMEFI和PINNEY两个字母实际上取得了稍差一些的结果。 并且每封信结果的最佳和最差的区别远小于他们向CLAWS报告的差异,表明与CLAWS等较传统的软件相比,在处理高度非标准文本时,LLMS的能力特别强.

blocks.en: Since we had both the training and test subsets of letters available from Saario-Ramsay et al., we have also experimented with various prompts to achieve both good Accuracy, but especially to improve the Macro F1 values. We have included the complete CLAWS7 guide including their examples of ambiguous or rare tag usage and we have also included the complete training subset. The Accuracy was roughly comparable, but Macro F1 was about 10% better when a training dataset was submitted in the prompt than with the detailed CLAWS7 guidelines.
blocks.zh: 因为我们既有来自Saario-Ramsay等人的培训和测试信件子集,我们还试验了各种诱因,以实现良好的准确性,特别是提高Macro F1值。 我们列入了完整的CLAWS7指南,包括它们使用模棱两可或罕见标签的例子,我们还列入了完整的培训子集。 精确度大致可以比较,但当培训数据集迅速提交时,Macro F1比详细的CLAWS7准则好约10%。

blocks.en: 5.2.6 T6: Semantic disambiguation of Middle English nouns
blocks.zh: 5.2.6 T6:中英名词的语义疏解

blocks.en: All models except for gpt-oss-120b reached over 95% Accuracy and the top runs reached over 99% in both Accuracy and Macro F1showing that this test is saturated for the current generation of LLMs. We can compare the results to our two human annotators who reached Accuracy of 93% (experienced postgraduate student of Middle English) and 99% (professor in the field of ME) showing the models are now on par with the top human annotators.
blocks.zh: 除gpt-oss-120b外,所有模型都达到95%以上的准确度,在精确度和Macro F1的显示中,顶端都达到99%以上,表明这一测试对当前一代的LLMS是饱和的. 我们可以将结果与我们两位人类的注释员进行比较,他们达到了93%的精确度(中英文的有经验研究生)和99%的精确度(ME领域的教授),显示模型现在与人类顶尖的注释员相当。

blocks.en: 5.2.7 T7: Lemmatization of Old English
blocks.zh: 5.2.7 T7:旧英语的Lemmatization

blocks.en: Accuracy on the Old English lemmatization task ranged from 69.37% to 98.74% across the recorded runs. Gemini-3 Flash Preview achieved the highest accuracy, agreeing with 2,810 of the 2,846 reference annotations, and the highest Macro F1 (92.70%). Differences between initial predictions and outputs following lexical validation are discussed with Figure 12 .
blocks.zh: 在有记录的全行中,英语的精度为69.37%至98.74%。 双子座-3闪光预览实现了最高的准确度,同意2,846个参考说明中的2,810个,以及最高的Macro F1(92.70%). 与图12讨论初步预测和经词汇验证后的产出之间的差异。

blocks.en: Qualitative assessment nevertheless revealed several difficulties arising from the relationship between the corpus annotations and the lexicon used by the validator. A number of headwords used as gold labels are absent from the validator lexicon, including mann , menniscnes and gescyldan . Other lemmas occur in the lexicon a different POS category: swilce , for example, is listed as an adverb but also functions as a preposition in the corpus, while se lacks a determiner entry. The lexicon also retains alternative headword spellings, including self/sylf , ful/full and andgit/andgyt . Consequently, instead of standardizing the predictions, the validator may confirm a variant prediction causing a mismatch against the gold labels. A further complication is the use of some slash-separated gold labels, such as heofon/heofone and wille/willa : which cannot match with single lemma predictions.
blocks.zh: 然而,定性评估表明,由于委托书说明与验证人使用的词汇之间的关系,出现了若干困难。 包括Mann、menniscnes和gescyldan。 其他的lemma在词典中出现一个不同的POS类:例如,swilce(swilce)被列作副词,同时也作为本体中的前置功能,而se缺乏一个确定者条目. 该词典还保留了替代的头字拼写法,包括自/sy,ful/full和andgit/andgyt. 因此,验证人不但没有将预测标准化,反而可能确认一个变异预测,导致与金牌不符。 另一种复杂情况是使用一些斜线分离的金色标签,例如heofon/heofone和Wille/Willa:它们不能与单一的lemma预测相匹配.

blocks.en: Some disagreements also expose inconsistencies or apparent errors in the gold labels. Latin pater is tagged both FW and NR, while noster/nostre likewise receive different treatment, affecting the applicability of the instruction to return foreign_word for FW tokens. Marian , referring to Mary, receives the reference label name , rather than a lexical headword or the designated foreign-word label. Other apparent errors of the gold labels used include geþeoþ assigned to geþeodan rather than geþeon , elles ‘otherwise’ assigned to eall , and three instances of fet ‘feet’ assigned to fæt ‘vessel’ rather than fot . These cases reinforce the interpretation of accuracy as agreement with the supplied annotations rather than an independent measure of linguistic correctness.
blocks.zh: 一些分歧还暴露了金色标签中的不一致或明显错误. 拉丁语的Pater被标记为FW和NR,而noster/nostre同样受到不同待遇,影响了FW符号返回外国语词的指示的适用性. 玛丽安(Marian)在提到玛丽时,会收到参考标签名称,而不是词汇头词或指定的外语标签. 使用金牌的其他明显错误包括:Geþeoþ被分配到Geþeodan而不是Geþeon, elles ' untherwise ' 被分配到ell, 以及三个fet ' feet ' 被分配到fæt ' vessel ' 而不是fot。 这些情况加强了对准确性的解释,因为它同意所提供的说明,而不是语言正确性的独立衡量标准。

blocks.en: Tichý’s ( 2017 ) rule-based morphological analyzer achieved 95% recall, rising to 97.3% with spelling-variation filters, but these figures measure inclusion of the correct analysis among potentially multiple alternatives rather than selection of a single contextually appropriate lemma. Our top Accuracy is substantially higher than the approximately 72% reported by Kawakami and Kawanami-Hanpeter ( 2022 ) for a rule-based lemmatizer using context-sensitive weighted edit distance on Ælfric’s De Sancta Eugenia . They also exceed the 67.58% held-out test accuracy reported in the documentation accompanying Arista’s ( 2026 ) character-level Transformer. These are contextual comparisons rather than equivalent evaluations: the studies differ in their samples, reference conventions and available linguistic information.
blocks.zh: Tichý’s(2017年)基于规则的形态分析器实现了95%的召回,随着拼写变异滤波器上升至97.3%,但这些数字衡量了潜在多种替代品中正确分析的包含程度,而不是选择一个符合上下文的单一lemma. 我们的最高精确度大大高于川上和川南-汉皮特尔(2022年)报告的大约72%, 此外,它们还超过了Arista(2026)字符级变换器所附文件中所报告的67.58%的悬浮测试精度。 这些是背景比较而不是同等评价:研究样本、参考惯例和现有语言信息各不相同。

blocks.en: 5.2.8 T8: Number of Old English nouns
blocks.zh: 5.2.8 T8:旧英语名词数.

blocks.en: The top result for this task is around 98% for both Accuracy and Macro F1, but smaller models perform significantly worse, c.f. qwen3.8-27b with 61% for both metrics, suggesting this test is still useful for less powerful models. Most of the differences between the predictions and the gold labels in the top runs involved the noun hand and specifically the OE construction to handa expressing possession rather than physical hand(s) and therefore semantically difficult to interpret in terms of number. The models‘ explanations reflect this and note that based on the formal interpretation, this is more probably dative singular than accusative plural. This is philologically sound explanation and should we accept it, the results reach over 99%.
blocks.zh: 这一任务的最高结果对精确度和Macro F1来说都是约98%,但较小的模型表现得更差,c.f. qwen3.8-27b对两个度量衡来说是61%,这表明这个测试对于不太强的模型仍然有用. 顶部的预测和金色标签之间的大多数差异都涉及到名词手,具体来说就是OE构造来表示拥有而不是物理手,因此在数量上很难解释. 这些模型 ' 的解释反映了这一点,并指出,根据正式的解释,这比起指控的复数,更有可能是 " 形容单数 " 。 这是哲学上合理的解释,如果我们接受,结果就超过99%。

blocks.en: In comparison, Domínguez Barragán ( 2024 , 297) reports approximately 90% performance for automatic assignment of grammatical number using a pretrained spaCy pipeline. This provides a broader morphological comparison, since the evaluation is not restricted to number-ambiguous nouns.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,Domínguez Barragán(2024, 297)报告,使用预训的温泉自动分配语法编号的性能约为90%. Cy 输油管。 这提供了更广泛的形态比较,因为评价不限于数字模糊的名词.

blocks.en: 5.2.9 T9: Sentiment analysis of the Movie Review Data
blocks.zh: 5.2.9 (中文(简体) ). T9:电影评论数据的感知分析

blocks.en: The overall success rate of the models’ predictions agreeing with the human annotators was ranging from 92.25% (gpt-5.4-mini) to 95.25% (glm-5.1). Inspection of the cases where the predictions did not agree showed that most of these statements contained both negative and positive aspects, so the decision was rather subjective. For example, the statement “light, cute and forgettable” was assessed by the human annotator as positive but by glm-5.1 as negative, with the model’s explanation: “While ‘light’ and ‘cute’ provide mild positive qualifiers, the conclusive term ‘forgettable’ acts as a strong negative judgment on the movie’s lasting value, outweighing the slight praise and resulting in an overall negative sentiment.” gpt-5.4-mini also assessed it as negative, with a similar explanation: “The node describes the movie as ‘forgettable,’ which is a negative. Although ‘light’ and ‘cute’ are mildly positive, the overall assessment is dismissive and unfavorable.” This suggests that the errors come mainly from items with mixed sentiment, not from an underspecified prompt or a failure of the models.
blocks.zh: 模型预测与人类注释者一致的总体成功率从92.25%(gpt-5.4-mini)到95.25%(glm-5.1)不等。 对预测不一致的案例的检查表明,这些陈述大多包含消极和积极两个方面,因此决定相当主观. 例如, " 轻、可爱和易忘 " 的说法被人类注释者评为正面,但glm-5.1则被评为负面,模型的解释是: “虽然`轻 ' 和`轻 ' 提供了温和的正面限定词,但最后的`忘却 ' 一词对电影的持久价值起到了强烈的负面评价作用,超过了微弱的赞美,并导致总体的负面情绪。” “节点将电影描述为‘忘却', 虽然`轻 ' 和`轻 ' 略为积极,但总体评估是否定的,是不利的。 这表明错误主要来自情绪不一的项目,而不是由于模型的不精确即时或失败.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: Our results indicate that LLMs represent a competitive tool for various NLP tasks – both in tasks where other NLP tools have been successful as well as in those that have so far resisted automatic annotation. We have shown competitive results for traditional tasks such as PoS annotation or lemmatization, specifically for highly varied and low-resource varieties (e.g. historical varieties of English) and for tasks highly reliant on semantic and contextual analysis, such as discourse-pragmatic categorization or semantic disambiguation. This does not mean that LLM annotation is suitable for every linguistic task, requiring word-internal segmentation, where difficulties in sub-token processing ( Hiraoka and Inui 2025 ) may limit performance (see section 7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,LLMs是各种NLP任务的一种竞争性工具,无论是在其他NLP工具成功的任务中,还是在那些迄今为止抵制自动注释的任务中。 我们对于诸如PoS注释或lemmatization等传统任务,特别是对于高度多样性和低资源品种(如英语的历史品种),以及高度依赖语义和背景分析的任务,如语义-语义分类或语义分化,都表现出了竞争的结果. 这并不意味着LLM注解适合每个语言任务,需要单词内部分解,在分解处理(平冈和井井2025)的困难可能限制性能(见第7节).

blocks.en: The efficiency of using LLMs for annotation has to be, however, assessed individually for each tasks. While it is difficult to estimate how resource intensive especially the commercial frontier models are, 21 21 21 Their authors publish little information on energy or water consumption, but price can be a useful proxy: more expensive models are probably more resource intensive. it is clear that they are in general more resource intensive than traditional deterministic NLP tools. Models we have benchmarked so far show large differences in prices: from Jev-1.13.0 at $0.00002 to gpt-5.4-pro at $0.28 estimated price per prediction. 22 22 22 These are different from advertised price per input/output tokens and are estimated from our own results and based on the total expense per model divided by its total predictions (annotation instances). They are influenced by the verbosity of the particular model, its “effort” or “thinking levels”, pricing tier, token caching etc. In other words, to lemmatize a corpus of 100 mil. Tokens can cost as little as $500 with Jev 23 23 23 Note that while we ran all open-weights models for free on a shared research infrastructure (e-INFRA CZ) and smaller models like qwen3.8-27b can easily run on current consumer hardware, this does not mean these do not consume resources and we have therefore used their listed prices with other providers used in this study to estimate their prices. or as much as $28 mil. with gpt-5.4-pro.
blocks.zh: 然而,在每项任务中,必须分别评估使用有限责任说明的效率。 虽然很难估计资源密集程度,特别是商业前沿模型,但21 21 其作者很少发表关于能源或水消耗的信息,但价格可以成为一个有用的代名词:更昂贵的模型可能更需要资源。 显然,它们一般比传统的确定性NLP工具更需要资源。 迄今我们的基准模型显示价格差异很大:从Jev-1.13.0美元(0.00002美元)到gpt-5.4-pro(0.28美元),按每次预测的估计价格计算。 22 22 这些模型与公布的每个输入/输出信物的价格不同,是根据我们自己的结果和按每个模型的总费用除以其总预测(注释例)。 它们受到特定模型的动词、其“努力”或“思考水平”、定价层次、信物缓存等的影响。 换句话说, 将一亿套套装起来。 Tokens与Jev 23 23 23相比成本可高达500美元 注意,虽然我们运行所有开放量级模型免费使用共享研究基础设施(e-INFRA CZ),而Qwen3.8-27b等较小的模型可以很容易地运行在目前的消费硬件上,但这并不意味着这些模型不消耗资源,因此我们用它们和其它在这项研究中使用的供应商的上市价格来估算它们的价格. 或高达2800万美元 加上Gpt -5.4

blocks.en: Therefore, LLMs should be used for annotation only when necessary and the less resource intensive (cheaper) models used in cases where their results are sufficient for the task at hand. However, it seems that in all our tasks, manual annotation would have been less efficient and only marginally more accurate in some of the tasks. Therefore, for our tasks, we can answer the question in Kuzman et al.’s paper ChatGPT: Beginning of an End of Manual Linguistic Data Annotation? ( 2023 ) with affirmative.
blocks.zh: 因此,只有在必要的情况下才应使用有限责任公司来作注释,如果其成果足以完成手头的任务,则应采用资源密集程度较低的模式。 然而,在我们的所有任务中,人工说明的效率似乎较低,在某些任务中只略微更准确。 因此,对于我们的任务,我们可以在Kuzman等人的论文《ChatGPT:开始手动语言数据注释的结束? 》 (2023)中以肯定的方式回答这个问题。

blocks.zh: 页:1 未来的研究

blocks.en: We also plan to extend the tool to handle more complex inputs and outputs, particularly XML, to facilitate features such as automating annotations according to Text Encoding Initiative (TEI) schemas.
blocks.zh: 我们还计划扩大这一工具,以处理更复杂的投入和产出,特别是XML,以促进诸如根据文本编码倡议(TEI)计划自动说明等特性。

blocks.en: Finally, we invite others to join: to look at our website and assess whether there are models suitable for their task, run the benchmarks themselves or approach us to run it for them, and use the tool to annotate their datasets.
